I didn't even want to  bother asking for coffee with dessert. My husband  felt we were troubling her too much if we had asked. 
The last time  I  dined here was about 5 years ago and it seems that it hasn't  changed  much.

The food is good, and this place is an office lunch spot weekly. But I was very upset when the food was packaged poorly, causing the food to leak into the bag, causing the bottom of the bag to fall out spilling our food all over the ground.

Dr. Burdorf and his staff are great, very easy going and personable.  Appointments are easy to book and waiting times are very little.  Dr. Burdorf has helped my neck feel much better and stronger. Also the cold laser that he uses has been very helpful to my neck and anywhere on the body there is pain or irritation.  In just the short amount of time that I have been going to Dr. Burdorf I have seen huge improvements in my health.

I used to go to this place all the time when i lived in Toronto. I figured i'd write something about it because i'm a bit home sick.  I have to say out of most of the AYCE places in Toronto this one is always the same. The fish is pretty fresh and the have a pretty big menu. You have to make sure everyone gets the full AYCE menu otherwise you all get charged for full menu. They are pretty strict on this rule. 

The tuna is nice and fresh. My favorit is the deep fried softshell crab which is on and off the menu. Its always on the menu but sometimes you can't get that AYCE. 

Great place, bit small.

SO EXTREMEELEY frustrated and dispointed. Run dont walk. I have been a customer for three years. I dont know what happened it used to be good but now its a disgrace. Worst customer service ever, incompentant and lazy. they have basically caused my dog to be delayed his medicine for over two weeks and still I havent recieved it. They tell you 5 days then a week later when you call : oh i dont see that order in the system blah blah let me call you back. they never call back. Then I had them expediate the shipment. Three days later i have to call these idiots and the same thing: i dont see any notes on that. WTF supervisor never calls back then i get a voicemail oh please call us back so we can discuss shipment options. WTF still havent sent it. I feel like suing these a-holes. Dont trust this company with your pets livlihood they dont care anymore. Maybe it has new managment idk but its a disgrace.

Six bucks and you have all you can eat pizza, salad, soup and desert. Pizza not to bad at all. Brownies and cinnamon rolls are so so GOOD. Would have given a five star but the place needs a good deep cleaning and a little TLC.

My husband and I are long time customers. We love visiting at least twice a week and 95% of the time we sit in the bar. Recently, we were in and decided to sit in the restaurant dining area. They were busy in the bar and invited the change. We noticed a substantial  change in our  service. Our beverages were ordered and it took a little while we felt as we still needed to.place our meal order. Once our order was delivered, we were not asked if we would like a refill on our beverages or anything else and we were out of salsa.

No one stopped by throughout our whole meal to see how it was, and if we needed anything.  We had never experienced this service here before. The funny thing was there was only one other table being attended to.

As we had left, I had told my husband how I felt about our experience and he agreed and stated we love tgis.pstlace and will.continue to visit but not be served by this waiter if he continues to work there.

We revisited recently and sat at the bar and I noticed the gentlemen that had been our waiter in the past was working. I truly hope he is spoken to as he stands out from the others for sure. The service there otherwise is  exceptional.

Great company and great service!

The pricing was lower than other companies. The owner Jim who came for the consult was a former police officer and gave us some great crime prevention advice. 

Great company and a good find!

I bought a beautiful couch, that is perfect for me!  I was lucky enough to buy it on senior day, and I qualified!  A great deal got even better!

Today I stopped and it was the first day of Christmas stuff and everything was 25% off.   I got wonderful bargains!

Home of crazy combination grilled cheese sandwiches and good sides make this a must try spot. We had heard about the grilled sandwiches, but were not prepared for how awesome the salads and soup are.

My meatloaf sandwich was huge with wonderful mashed potatoes squishing out.  The side salad was a perfect balance to its hearty flavors.

Love this place and its quirky, smart and helpful waiters.

Exquisite.  Every bite was perfection.  Service is extremely attentive and knowledgeable. Really lovely space too.

Dim sum at its finest.  Order a bunch of dishes and wait to be blown away! They have seasonal specials that I would highly recommend.  

It's pricey, but worth it for a special occasion.  (We went for my birthday and they gave us a complimentary dessert!)

Do not rent here if you don't have to. This is especially true if you are renting on a temporary basis. The rent is exceptionally high for the quality of the accommodations and the size of the townhomes. Additionally, the utilities are grossly inflated. The HVAC systems are extremely old and in poor condition; that, coupled with little to no insulation creates exorbitant electric and gas bills. Further, the water is determined by how many people are in your apartment with no means of determining how much was actually used. We have two adults and two preschool aged children and the water ranges between $65-$90 a month. I can only assume that the facility is passing off their costs for the swimming pool and maintaining the landscaping on the tenants. In addition to all of that, everything is in poor condition. We have our circuits replaced almost monthly and have to flip the breakers weekly. The blinds fall off of the windows, there are immense amounts of insects and snakes in and around the property, and the staff are unhelpful. If I save even one person from renting here, I will sleep better.

Great Ceasar salad that can be eaten according to  Tim the manager. . Put bread in the plate that was hard as a rock. Later was said to be a bowl ... I guess in a bowl ..  atmosphere and waitress was great.  Poor excuse for a Cease r salad

this was some of the worst chinese food i've ever had. everything i ordered was incredibly salty. the tofu was not cooked very well and the fried rice, aside from being too salty, was rather bland. plus they didn't throw in any spicy mustard.

on the plus side, the food was pretty cheap, and the delivery was free and quick.

this place might be good in a pinch, but otherwise seek out better chinese options.

This place is super clean. The staff is so nice and the food is great! It's not greasy or overly breaded. I love the apples with toffee sauce too. You could put that toffee on anything and it would be amazing. The sauces are delicious. My personal favs so far are the sweet heat and creamy garlic. I've tried the chicken tenders and grilled turkey sandwich, both had great flavor and served hot and fresh! I definitely recommend trying this place!

Cute little dessert spot any one in Toronto would want to check out. The menu is quite small but all flavours are unique and have interesting combinations. I got the cookie monster double scoop and it was really good, the flavour is not very prominent but it was good it had the oreo, cookie and cream flavour. At the end you do get a blue stain on your lips- if you like that kind of stain. I really enjoyed the oreo waffle cone it was bomb! I initially wanted to grab their egg tarts as well but because of the spring/summer season they dont serve it- only served in the winter months ): 
Overall its a good dessert shop thats creative and tastes good.

I haven't been here in a while.  Last few times was so disappointing, such small meat portions but huge mounds of rice.   Smallest meat portions I've seen in a long time.  Which I hate to say bc I LOVE Korean food.  

Went here the other day and ordered the Korean rolls.   They were warm and delicious.  Good portion size and meat portion was nice in the roll.  Which is very nice.  The woman at the front is nice and the place looked clean.  

Can't wait to go back and try the food again, hopefully portion sizes went up

New(ish) joint from Justin Severino.  Tapas.  Spain by Disney.  Angry bartendress.  Boomin'/ crowded.  I was solo, so I had chorizo plate.  I have the same complaint about Morcilla and about Cure..... where I had steak tartare.  The concept/ vibe of both buildings I found inviting but in a Damien Hirst kinda way.

Morcilla has gotten an infinite amount of attention and praise.  It's worth going to see what "the best Pittsburgh has to offer".

Chicken and waffles. Chicken...AND waffles? It sounded strange at first, really it did. We gave them a call for a delivery and a very quick 25 minutes later I opened the door to a wonderful aroma. The fried chicken was AMAZING, the skin came right off and the seasoning was just right. The eggs were cooked to order perfectly, over-medium. It came with a side of gravy that I ended up just eating by itself, it was delicious and I don't even like gravy. Once that was done, I had two warm, fluffy Belgian waffles covered in butter with a side of warm syrup and it was in that moment that I understood. Chicken and waffles makes all the sense in the world. Whether you love it already or you are curious to find out, I highly recommend Jorge's Chicken and Waffles!

WOW Is how I feel about this place.  Since the new owner took over last year he has been continually making improvements in service food quality and selection.  I drop in for breakfast and lunch mostly and I have enjoyed every meal.  The lunch specials have been a surprise of quality and presentation, much more than you would expect for a restaurant of this type.

They are now open Sunday and certainly worth to take the family too without going bankrupt.  

This place is Toronto's Best Kept Secret!
Not too bad, service was a little slow, but food was good.

I dropped off my motorhome for some final warranty repair work that was messed up at the factory repair center. While it was there, I decided to have a Winegard Trav'ler installed. The work was first class! Some of the poor work performed by the factory repair center was fixed and looked very professional. In addition, they had to fabricate a special mount due to the slope of my roof. The mount is solid and should last forever, and the dish works great. I recommend these guys wholeheartedly. It's a 2 hours drive from my house, but the quality of work is worth the trip.

I can't speak to the length of time to repair the RV since I told them there was no rush. It's the busy time of year, but the repair tech took the time to review everything with me before I took the vehicle.

If you're into pinball machines, old and new, this is your place.  Hundreds of machines of almost every genre--the old "newly electrified" games of the late 40s, solid-state games of the 70s and 80s, shooting games, all the way to digital machines--all working and lovingly maintained under one roof.  Take your quarters or small bills, and enjoy an afternoon here.  I liked that the machines take their original amount, so most machines are still just a quarter.

There are also drink and candy machines (not just a quarter) in the building.  If you're staying at one of the casino resorts along the Strip, it is easy to get there by cab--maybe $10 or so, each way.  If you're willing to navigate the transit system, it's a pleasant couple of buses to get there.
Theft is a problem at the Venetian. Risk Management and Security feign concern but do nothing. Requests that footage from security cameras be viewed are ignored. Protect yourself. The staff won't.

Went to the mall for shoes for my husband.  Tried all the big name dept. stores with no luck.  Stopped in more for me than him.  Best customer service we had all evening.  Nice lady working, polite and friendly.  We need more like this in the world.  I've always been a fan of Payless and this experience was very good.

We went there yesterday and we have a really good time nice place nice service what to Oslo will the only one there by 8 30...pm Jim was frendly , attentive accommodating but once again not too much fun it on the empty restaurant please people support the place and go there its a nice place now in the strip casino Trap  lol ....
Use the Gruponn good deal ....
And tip well that way we can get great service. ...
Poor service and food was mediocre at best. The side of potato was about the only thing I ate that was good and they show no love to veterans or military families.

Very good doesn't do this awesome pizza joint justice. 
Youll have to make up new words when you bite into their delicious crispy crust yet the top is light as air. Topping qre high quality. Please do your self a favor and try the meatballs. They are top notch made fresh daily.

Located at the East side ghetto of Las Vegas. A popular stop for cab and limo drivers. When you first walk in, they look at you like deer caught in head lights. They didn't seat me and my boyfriend right away until I told the pretty Ethiopian girl, it'd be for 2, please! Yes, I agree with past posts about a language barrier, vbut it helps to be educated on Ethiopian cuisine or any cuisine that you guys decide to go venture.

I ordered the fresh beef tartar, curried beef, sauteed spinach and feta style cheese, with a side salad. All served on top of a large size engari bread, shaped like a sourdough pancake. My boyfriend had the grilled lamb, beef tartar, spinach & feta style cheese with a side salad, We didn't think we'd get full from their scoop sized portions. The bread helped get us there. No wonder their portions were small, they knew you'd get full with the bread. The flavors were intense. The bread kept coming, the pretty, young lady even looked us down when we told her no more on the bread to eat the last bits of meat on our plates.

The soda's aren't refillable, as they sell soda by the can. I wish they had fountain style soda, cause all that bread can clog your esophagus. There's nothing better that that Las Vegas water. mmm hmmm! Next time we come in, we'll bring at least one more person, so we can enjoy the coffee ceremony. We'd probably order their vegetable platter and their assorted meat platter as well.  

I wish there were half ratings. It was actually close to a 5, but I didn't like the whole feeling in the beginning about them not hesitating to serve us!

Where do you go when you feel down or feel the need improve your health? 

Rainbow Clinic & Holistic Yoga!

Of all the the wonderful things I could say about this place I would begin by describing it as a the perfect love child of meditative yoga and medical services. If I feel sick to my stomach, I go here. If I feel stressed or uneasy and need to stretch my body, I go here. The best of both worlds now available in Las Vegas in one place. They take such a simple yet result driven approach at healing your body and your mind together. 

When it comes to taking care of your overall health there are many factors involved that a "pill a day" won't resolve. The master instructor is also a certified registered nurse practitioner and will walk you through the best approach to healing yourself by striking the right balance of physical activity and medicinal options. This approach has helped me become more educated on how to customize the way I heal my mind and my body to fit my needs. 

I've been attending now for about 2 years and have to say that it's the best decision I have ever made. It's like a sanctuary of peace and healing for me when the world around seems to be in chaos at times. I feel like many others can benefit from this like I have. 

I recommend anyone give it a try if you're just curious or seeking to change the daily habits that keep breaking your health. After all, you have nothing to lose and everything to gain.
The flavors we had today were so amazing. This is my new obsession. I had Caramel Balsamic Fig and my husband had Chocolate Rum Raisin. You MUST check this place out.

This Jim is the Manager (thats what he told me as soon I ask him for the manager) is very rude doesn't have any idea how treat customer I ask prices over the phone he keep claiming "I has to see the vehicle" (give me a break you don't know how much is oil change)!?? Is a joke going down there they said 30 min for this and after 2 hours they still saying give me a couple min

Always the best!  Great food, service, and atmosphere!  We've been coming in here for 20 years and it is consistently fabulous!  I love their specials of the day and the pancakes are obviously out of this world.

I've been here 3 times, and it seems to get worse with each visit. They never have enough people to make salads and the ones they do have are unhappy to be there, don't speak English, or don't know the items on the salad bar (artichokes & beets look nothing alike and when asking for quinoa - I had to tell them which container it was in). This place has a long way to go!!!

Went here tonight for the first time with friends, will not be back. Sat at the bar for almost 10 minutes before bartender even acknowledged us. Once we were seated it was fine  waiter was nice, took our order right away, but once the food came it was a different story. Someone else brought our food, my friend and I ordered fajitas and we're not given our tortillas. It took 10 to 15 minutes before I was able to flag down our waiter to ask for them, when he brought the tortillas back we told him that our meal  hot and he offered to "reheat" them... we declined, as our other friends had almost finished their meals.  He never asked us if we wanted another round of drinks. He brought the bill and didn't take anything off our bill or offer free desert to compensate. I asked for the manager who listened, apologized, and said he'd adjust the bill; our waiter brought the bill back telling us he had taken $5 off each of our meals.  As we were leaving, the manager came back to offer us a $10 off coupons. We turned them down because we felt disappointed in how they handled our situation...why would we want to come to back here?!
Absolutely spectacular service and amazing food.  I don't write many reviews but this restaurant deserves a good review.

Social House rocks. And IMO, some of the best sushi in Vegas. We discovered it before a show when it used to be at TI. The move to Crystals was a smart one, as its too good for TI. The first time we dined there, we decided to test the waiter & let him pick, course by course, everything we had to eat that night. We asked him his recommendations, house favorites & we spent the next 3 hours, sipping champagne, inviting the couple next to us to join us & experiencing some of the best dining in our life. Now we go every trip to Vegas. If you can only stop by for Happy Hour, do it! Its fantastic.

When we arrived at 11:20 it was packed. There were hundreds of people outside, I was not expecting that. We got to the guest list line with 5 minutes to spare and had the bouncers check their phone, look back up at us and say "you're done for it" after I checked my phone to verify it was past 11:30 (it was 11:25!) and he goes "here's an idea, how about you show up before 11:30 so you can get in, if not, you don't get it" I smiled and left because some people just can't be helped. No intention of lining up after so we went to Dave & Busters close by and that was so much fun!!!

The customer service rep Lance at the front desk  Answered the phone very professionally and was very courteous and nice. Then we came to check and he knew exactly who we were answer all of our questions and gave us all of the specials and told us where we could park in how to get in the best way he was very very nice! The air could pump a little better out into the living area of the room.
Very high quality. I tasted the apple fritter, crumb and blueberry cake. All were quite fresh with a moist, springy consistency. I particularly like the apple fritter.

How fun like eating in an Italian grocery store in the middle of NYC.  Here on Monday night and this place is packed. That's  always a good sign.  Had to wait in line to order, but if the foods good who cares.  I am a Lasagna snob. I grew up  living not to far from little Italy in NYC so we will see.  I ordered the meat lasagna with 4 cheeses, and my husband ordered a reuben.  They did ask if he wanted corn beef or pastrami, which is good. OMG, just like my home made lasagna.  It was wonderful. Would I come back? You betcha!!

Giving these guys five stars because I can't think of anything that would have made our experience any better.  We sat on the patio in the back which is right against a parking lot but we quickly forgot that. The atmosphere was relaxed and rustic. Our sever John had the perfect balance of attentiveness without our party feeling rushed or bothered. The Bruschetta is the star and a must try! Be brave and try them all. We also had the watermelon salad and tomato bisque followed by the duck and short ribs. Everything on the menu was a taste adventure. I will be back for sure. It was a delightful experience.

Frankly, I was disappointed. As someone who lived in Italy and tasted the real thing, Pizzeria Pomo makes considerably better pizzas than Pizzeria Bianca. Further,  pizzeria Pomo offers much larger variety of pizzas and at a lesser cost.

This is a perfect place for a date or an appetizer and wine, but it isn't my favorite pizza or Italian place in town. Next time I'll try the pasta, because it looked divine. 


They have great specials! They are very kind to wine drinkers as well. When I first went I did not know my wines very well (I still don't) and they brought me several samples without me even asking. Fantastic service!

Hadn't been to AZ Kabob house in a while - and my lunch buddy was in the mood for gyros.

AZ Kabob house is our current favorite gyros and etc. place in north Phoenix.

I got the gyro wrap - very good.  Gyro meat was not dry - tzaziki sauce was spot on - plenty of lettuce, tomato, and pickle slices instead of cucumber (different, but I have to pick the cucumber out - makes me burp - so I kind of liked this idea!).  Came with a small side salad.

My friend ordered the chicken kabob - just looking at it, I could see it was cooked perfectly - I could see that it was juicy (confirmed by asking, though, just to be safe ;-)).

Everybody working there was friendly - big smiles.  Really not sure why we hadn't been in a while (a little outside our normal lunch radius, I guess).

If you've got a hankering for middle eastern food, give AZ Kabob House a try - you'll be happy - and if you order a piece of baklava, you'll be ecstatic!
Good food for a good price! Everything was presented well, and all of the food was fresh. They seem quite popular! The service was friendly and quick.

The defining feature of BLD is not just the design, but the attitude and ambience.  When returning to Chandler, I make it a point to stop at BLD as I am guaranteed an enjoyable evening.  The menu has the ideal artisan experience and offsets the pricing.  Best of all, the patio is canine friendly and makes for a wonderful evening.

Love it!

It is super fresh, open kitchen concept, and they have fish burritos. Found the wait a little long, but I will follow the Yelper's advice about calling in the order ahead of time.

Halibut burrito, spicy, you can't go wrong. 

Oh and the guacamole...is perfect.

Ps. I skipped on the rice to make it a little more carb friendly- and it was JUST as delish!

Don't ask me if I stayed here, because I'll tell you right now:

I have never stayed here, and I will NEVER stay here. Although it looks amazing from the outside, we went inside to go to a bar or a club, and the second we opened the outer doors, the smell hit us like a ton of bricks! It smells so bad in the Venetian, I don't think I'll ever be back to visit, let alone pay my good money to stay here. It literally smells like a staircase that has been pissed on for years, mixed with stale urinal cakes from a dive bar bathroom. 

Please know that this is NO EXAGGERATION.

We about faced and got the hell out of dodge, because there is no way that I can have a great time with friends when it smells like a port-o-san.

I'm not sure how there are people who went recently and have not noticed this problem, but it is out of hand.
Service was quick and friendly. Walked in to have a battery changed in a watch took only five minutes to get in and out. I've been here only once before to check out some watches.

Do go there for take out when they are busy; they will tell you they are too busy to take your order.  Then they will tell you that it will be 10-15 minutes before they can take your order and run off! C

I lived in Thailand for 2 years, and I'm pretty Thai-food snobby.

So far this has been the only Thai place I've liked in the Henderson/Vegas area.

Soups and grilled foods are authentic.

Great wine list, especially for a Thai restaurant.

Came here for the NYE prix fixe.  Good food and good company made the night very memorable.  We started with the oyster amuse bouche which was lovely and delicate.  I had the squab as the starter and although I was so tempted to pick that little sucker up and eat it with my hands, I thought better of it.  It was nicely roasted and very evenly seasoned.  And though it was kind of hard to eat, I think I managed to scrape all the meat off those tiny bones.  I had a taste of my friend's onion soup with was velvety and rich.  
Next stop was the sturgeon - a serious misstep on my part.  The fish was cooked very well, but the sauce on the scallop dish blew the sturgeon out of the water....(pun intended).  
Everyone else had the short-rib (a trend that I do enjoy but am rather tired of).  But I, being the soul-less foodie that I am went with the veal chop.  It was a nice bone-in, thick cut of baby cow.  I'm forgetting the accompaniments now, but it was a nicely seasoned piece of meat.
The dessert was the baked alaska which fell short of my favorite incarnation at the Oceanaire.  It had a nice charred merengue over huckleberry and a lemon poppyseed cake.  A little tart, but refreshing after the meat heavy meat.
The NYE price was a deal at this LV main-staple.  I can't wait to try the blue cheese souffle that I've been reading so much about.

Highly recommended, Authentic Korean restaurant BBQ! This restaurant is clean has good service, definitely a place you'd want to come back. Prices are fair compare with the Quality of the meat. Besides the BBQ there are great other Korean dishes, you must try it!

My girlfriend and I came here and had a great stay. The location was convenient, the price was great and it was very clean and comfortable. If you are going to stay here beware that the walls are extremely thin. We could hear our neighbors watching television and talking all weekend. The hallways are also very loud so you can hear everyone walking past the room. The grounds of the hotel are very nice. The pool was gorgeous, the hotel lobby was nicely done and the hotel had a nice breakfast every morning. I would stay here again but I would make sure to ask for a corner room with no neighbors!

I don't like Asian food but this place changed my mind.  I asked the server the difference between Shaken Salmon and Caramelized Salmon.  He informed me the Shaken was made with their soy sauce and other ingredients.  The Caramelized was sweeter and made with molasses.  
Even though the dishes were not delivered at the same time everything was served hot and stayed hot.  The salmon was sizzling on top of sliced onions and cut into 4 pieces for the serving.  The rice, soup and salad where served on another platter.  The dressing was lite for the salad and the soup was hot and excellent.  The rice was shaped like a large patty and I had leftover rice from the dinner.  
The service was great and the server asked if he could remove dishes instead of just taking them off the table.  
We went a little earlier than dinner time but when we left the place was beginning to fill up with customers and each was greeted in a very friendly manner.  I hope to return here in the near future.

Everything was delicious! Ordered chicken fingers and a side salad. Everything was hot and tasted cooked! The ranch was a special mix they did and was tasty! 10/10 would recommend if you're looking for a great pizza place and is also cheap!
The Workway in Scottsdale is no better. Very unprofessional and not organized at all. Terrible listening skills and rude.

one word .. Cheap!
tuesday is $1 movie day and the others are $1.50! 

it gets pack on weekends. get there earlier in the day.smaller theaters but decent looking..

I bookmarked Tom's Thumb on Yelp years ago, so it took awhile, but I finally made my way there to check it out first hand last week... 

I wanted the full experience, so I filled my car up with gas, left it with Ivan to get the signature wash, and headed inside to check out the general store and enjoy some breakfast.  I admired the bakery treats to my left as I entered, but I'd already had a cup of coffee that morning, so I kept on walking toward the restaurant counter... 

I ended up with a delicious 2 egg breakfast.  I asked for my eggs over medium and for my sides, I chose the creamy grits and sliced tomatoes.  For toast, I asked for a whole wheat tortilla.  I love that option.  I enjoyed it all!

I found the service to be friendly and the seating options comfortable.  While I didn't make any purchases from the store beyond my breakfast, I enjoyed looking around as they have a variety of gifts and convenience items.  It's an awesome one-stop shop!  Clean bathrooms to boot!

I left with a full belly, fueled up for the day and feeling great.  My car did too!

Tom's Thumb is a unique gem of a business that is absolutely worth a visit, even if you have to drive out of your way to check it out.  I'd be a regular if I lived closer, but I'll absolutely return... maybe even with the kids in tow next time!

Visited 1st time today at lunch. Why fly to Austin when Little Miss BBQ does it up just right here in Phoenix? 
Looking forward to my next visit. GET HERE EARLY, don't delay or you will miss out!
Staff was super friendly and engaged with customers. The sushi was amazing and was ready 5 minutes after we ordered! We will definitely be returning the next time we are in Phoenix!

First and last time at Modern Nails on Union Hills Blvd.  The gentleman who did my fill did a good job, although his supplies, table and the things sitting on the table were grubby.  

The pedicure was another matter.  Again, the gentleman was attentive.  But I paid for a callus removal, and the guy used one of those lame Dollar Store implements rather than a proper rasp, which means that the result was about what you would expect. 

But the real disappointment - which was pure incompetence: I selected a soft pink color from the shellac examples.  The result, which only showed up when the second coat was applied to the nails, was a lurid, tacky bright pink. Turns out that they prepared the "example" with only one coat of shellac, which resulted in a completely different shade. Although I was not charged for their error,  I didn't have time to have the entire shellac process redone so my pedicure looks like it was applied in a house of ill repute. 

As icing on this disastrous cake, the manager was loud and made sexually and racially suggestive jokes, and they turned off the Arizona State Bowl game while patrons were watching it.

Just love this place. Love the food, the cold beer and Amanda the bartender. This place is a diamond in the rough. They possibly have the best burger in town at a great price. Ask for Walter the chef, great guy and always willing to satisfy.
Here in Phoenix from out of town and looking for a good place to eat dinner. I happened upon Wild Thaiger. Great food and cocktails. Good value. Highly recommend!
Best burger I've had from a fast food establishment ever.  And the burgers actually look like they do in the pictures and not sloppily thrown together.

This place is so unorganized it should be county. The left hand certainly doesn't know what the right hand is doing. Went in for my medication (xanax) first Dr I saw didn't write for that so put me on a anti depressant. 2 weeks later it wasn't working. Saw Dr. Pragit. She didn't like what the previous Dr had me on took me off that then put me on 1mg xanax and reffered me to another Dr within mydrnow. Now I'm seeing a different Dr. Irons. Doesn't listen to me complains why Dr. Pragit put me on the xanax if she was just gonna pawn me off. Gives me now 2mg xanax. Next visit Williams-Vaughan. She thinks she is not only a Dr but a psychiatrist . She doesn't like xanax and is trying to find out of something traumatic happened to me when I was younger. Always she fills it and adds another medication. Next visit (I could never see the same doctor for some reason.) Monte Jones. I went in a week early because my family was going camping and I would not have been in town. He writes me a script for #20 pills till I could see Dr. Snyder. So now I meet Dr. Snyder, I must say he was the only Dr that listened and helped. Oh by now I'm on 40mg celebs,4mg xanax and 500mg gabapentin. Which by the way is a joke. Now Dr.Snyder started doing something for me he wasn't supposed to and that was put refills on my xanax. Well it came that time for me to get another prescription and Dr. Snyder wasn't in so I had to see miss wonderful Williams-Vaughan. The dumb bitch wrote me a fake script. While in the exam room she told me she hated it . I was too high on a dose and walks out to write my refill. Thinking nothing of it I didn't look at it till I got home. The crazy bitch set me up. She wrote me a script for #280 pills and the paper seal wasn't even stamped it looked like I made it at home! I went back and I saw Dr.Snyder and showed him and he went and made a copy by this time he comes in and tells me he is no longer allowed to write scripts for me. My file is frozen. Anyway they kicked me off the program. Refusing to give me my medical records been 5 months. And Dr. Snyder no longer works there. I just filed a complaint with the medical board because that clinic is shady and I don't trust nobody!! I'm just glad the DEA hasn't flagged me for seeing so many damn doctors.
the "tofu fa" is the best here! silky smooth, melts in your mouth! get it hot!

I've never had such a soggy pizza! The Bianca wasn't as soggy but the marinara--dear god please send help from Blaze or Pieology. Just because you're located in Vegas does NOT mean you can skimp out on the amount of each topping you give. $1.50 for each topping??? Ridiculous. So dissatisfied!

Delivery is quick and fast. The drivers are always pleasant and friendly.  The wait time is short on the phone.  We order the mega meat, salad and breadsticks with cheese...this loacatuon has THE best crust and sauce to cheese ratio.  When my sister and cousin come from the west valley they order from THIS barros coz they say my barros us better than theirs.

We have also had wings and subs delivered at other times and it was also great!
I have been enjoying the food here for a couple of years. I have recently noticed they are using a great deal of sugar in all of their dishes. Just a warning if you are diabetic.

Big fan of this place. I work at the building next door and love coming in here for their healthy and actually really tasty healthy food. Their proteins are solid, but it's their sides that are what pack all the flavour. I've tried almost all the combinations and have never been disappointed. Only reason it's not 5 stars is because of the price, $17 for a lunch is a little too much for me. Pantry down at Rosedale has a similar offering with similar portions for cheaper.

Coal Burger offers a healthier spin on your normal fast food burger place, which is refreshing. You can satisfy your craving and not feel too guilty about it after. Also, they  are very eco-friendly, from the straws they use, to the materials their tables are made of, even the bathrooms stress green-ness. 

I normally get the 1/3 coal burger on a gluten free bun with mixed fries. This amount of food always leaves me full, but not with the heavy feeling of a greasy meal. Which is something that I love about them - no nasty grease! The fries are cooked in rice oil, the beef is coal fired, AND they have gluten free buns?? It is really nice to have options when it comes to this kind of cuisine. 

The service is great, everyone is friendly. My order is always comes out perfect, just like I ordered it. 

I give the 4 star rating because I haven't tried a lot of other items on their menu.
Best place for food and drinks!! GREAT service! Megan is the best waitress!!! Will definitely come back!

Went in today before lunch to get some new nail supplies. I asked the manager of the store what I need for a beginners nail kit. He walked me through the store and told me what I needed. Iwould give it 5 stars if some of the prices were lower. But overall they have a great selection to choose from.They do host classes and give a student/ license discount. Best beauty supply in Vegas so far.

The food, the drinks, and the service all are good.  Everything I have tried from the menu, from appetizers to sandwiches and burgers to the entrees, have exceeded expectations.  Sometimes the music IMO is too loud, and often the selections are, well, unpleasant and out of sync with the diners.  But, it still is an enjoyable place to dine.

Today I decided to get a haircut while on vacation in Vegas, and I found this barbershop. When I saw the dedication that each of the barber took with each client, I knew I was getting a nice haircut and shave. Richie was my barber and he did a fabulous job. The owner Martin was a very friendly guy and he also is a great barber. It was an amazing experience.

This is a wonderful place! There is a great selection of top quality pet supplies/foods & low prices, that is what got me in the door the first time. 

I no longer live near here, but I go out of my way to still come here. What makes me a diehard Pet Food Depot is the best place ever, I wouldn't dream of going anywhere else person, is the service. They have the best customer service, ever.  They welcome you walking in, while you are walking around ask if you would like help or have questions.  If there is a line they acknowledge it, and typically get another person to help (not that I mind waiting in line here because the other customers are mostly sweet people who are fun to talk to). 

One thing that they always go above and beyond with is if someone has bought something "heavy," like 25lbs or more.  Even if there is a super long line, they will at the very least ask if you would like help taking your purchase out to your truck, and it is not because they have to ask you, it is a genuine want to help people.  I can't even tell you the number of times where I have finished paying and another employee already has my entire purchase slung over their shoulder and is asking me where my car is!

This was no easy project since I live in a second floor condo. Currently there is no washing machine in place.  I had gotten a few bids for the job but Ken made the difference when he assured me he was up to the job.  Part of the job required them to dig a three foot hole 7 feet long at the base of my building. They worked hard and non stop all day. Joel and MJ were polite young men and all three got along well all day, despite the 100 plus temperatures. I had no idea the job was going to be so extensive. A camera had to be installed to locate the drain. Which was done in advance to assure me the project could be accomplished in the first place.  Dispatchers Craig and Cheyenne kept me informed each time a crew was enroute with an accurate arrival time to my house. Ken was there for the first visit and saw the project through the end. Questions were answered throughout the day and they even helped to document this part of my complete kitchen makeover by taking pictures for me inside the hole they had dug. I won't look anywhere else when the time comes to install the kitchen plumbing. This was a positive experience. Ken, Joel, and MJ made the difference.

To begin with,
Ive been to taco Y taco 3 times. The last visit was by far the worst. To begin with the restaurants layout is marginal at best.  It's confusing and has multiple lines, which would be a cool concept if other people had the same understanding. We waited in line for probably 10 minutes because everyone was just as confused as I was. Finally, we squeeze our way through to the front of the burrito line, and we were met with the absolute worst customer service my small brain could imagine. Being a restaurant connoisseur, I knew I wanted Al Pastor which was the meat for my burrito. She asked what I want, and I had to repeat myself 4 times before she interrupted saying that there was no Al Pastor. I saw it? But that didn't discourage me. Being a Good Samaritan, I kept going without a complaint. When I sat down to eat, the food was dry and bland, and tasted low quality. Me and my squad will never return to here. We are utterly hungry and pitifully disappointed. Chipotle Is two miles down the street.

Horrible service. Had make an appointment at 7 pm but told me they can only do part of the service as no time. 

Not a good job at pedicure. Will never come back!

Stopped in early morning and just had time to grab a coffee. The interior is really fun and the staff is excellent. I can't wait to come back and try some breakfast! I want to give them more stars for having almond milk at their beverage bar because I appreciate that they are conscious of people's dietary habits.

I love poking around in here, but I didn't love the experience at their last bag sale. For the uninitiated, a bag sale means a shopping event where you are given a plastic bag, and from a certain section of the store (usually out-of-season stuff), you can fill it up for $20.

Unlike other locations that hang up the clothes, the Bloor-Bathurst location unceremoniously dumped everything in a few plastic bins. Very unpleasant, messy, and inefficient to dig through these with other shoppers. 

In addition, we all found it frustrating that at this location, one of the staff members refused to let customers try on any of the bag sale clothing before buying it. I get that a bag sale is like a clothing buffet for $20, but honestly, when customers get rebuked for even thinking of trying a pair of jeans on, something is definitely wrong. 

They've got some good stuff, but the manager should definitely have an extra person on staff during the bag sale so that we can try before we buy. We're not made of money; that's why many of us are shopping there in the first place. Honestly now.

My son absolutely loves going to speech here, it is the highlight of his week. We loved Melissa and are so grateful for the progress that our son made with her. The therapists are always friendly and welcoming and they make learning fun and enjoyable for the kids. We would highly recommend Rescue My Speech!

My team and I had a great experience with all the staff!  They attended to every one of our needs including specific dietary restrictions. The staff was kind enough to help me celebrate my birthday and allowed my team to bring in a cake and sing me happy birthday!  Everyone went above and beyond for my team and I and I am forever grateful. I can't wait to go back and visit with the friendly staff when I go back to Vegas.

When I originally brought my vehicle in, they quoted me $2,200 worth of work needed on a vehicle that was only worth about $1,800. However, after a few discounts, they got it down to $1,750. They also assured me they'd looked over the whole vehicle, and that it was worth saving, and worth investing my money in. That it didn't need anything else. Boy they could not have been more wrong.

While still in the shop for the first repair, right before they returned it to me, another part failed, and I had to add another $200 to my cost for repairs.

Within a week of the first repair, the vehicle went down again, for a second fault that they failed to identify the first time, which was another $615 repair.

And now, less than a month later, it needs repairs again - at least another $600. The repairs they've done have been OK, but promising me my vehicle was worth saving when I've now had to put twice its value into it just to get it to start doesn't work for me.

They should have just told me they didn't know if the vehicle was worth saving or not. Then, I could have made a more informed decision about the repairs. Instead, they were so desperate for the revenue that they made a bad recommendation, and now I'm stuck with it.

I absolutely would not recommend going here. They will tell you whatever they think you need to hear to get work done with them, regardless of whether it is in your best interests or not.

If you're looking for a good crowd, decent prices and very competent bartenders this is your place. We had a great time with friends and met people from all over the country. 

This place is fun, loud, exuberant and engaging.

We literally just left: we were looking for Chinese food in the area and came across this restaurant. 
Parking: lots of parking spots as its part of a plaza
The atmosphere was nice, good for a casual date, family dinner. Stroller friendly somewhat. There could be more seating, I can imagine it gets packed weekends. 
The food was very delicious, had a mix of some spicy dishes and not so spicy. Both were good, although their menu has a lot of spicy food options. 
We ordered: 
Chicken fried rice - really good, chunks of chicken, well cooked
General Tao - mild spicy, crispy, sauce was nice 
Spicy Green Beans - over killed the chilli peppers won't get this again
Cant Chow Mein - crispy noodles, but the sauce lacked some flavour 
Shanghai dry shrimp - really good, crispy and big shrimp 
Wonton soup - simple but delicious 
Overall: I would definitely come back and would recommend to anyone who wants good Chinese food and can handle some heat 

Service was great too, got our orders pretty quick and the servers were quick to clean up and check up on us. We were a group of 6.

This definitely a spicy/ Hakka Chinese food restaurant.

This update is long overdue. Since I initially posted this review, I've gone back...and I'm ashamed to admit this...1-2 times a week in the past two months. 

Okay, okay - I know, complete and total insanity, but there's a reason: my boyfriend started the keto diet back in February and apparently chicken wings are totally acceptable keto fare.

With that in mind, when he first suggested we go back to this location, I was staunchly opposed. With some debate, I finally threw my hands up in the air and relented - at least I knew what to expect if they failed.

That's when Alexis happened. Now, I shouldn't say this as if this was the first time we've crossed paths with her - we've had Alexis take care of us before, she's always a ray of sunshine, positive, bubbly, welcoming and thoughtful. She's the one who's always recalled our order perfectly and taken such great care of us.

But she *is* the reason we've decided to continue our patronage to this location. I've pushed the prior experience to the depths of my mind and have decided to let it go as an off night for the waitress. 

Alexis is truly the best thing to happen to this location and we've continuously left her generous tips since to express our thanks for her consistent thoughtfulness, and warm demeanour. She is someone who you can truly tell genuinely loves her job, the people she works with and the customers. She always asks about things you've shared with her on previous visits - be it my boyfriend's keto diet, or DIY projects. 

We are continuously touched by the extra length she always goes to in an effort to make sure we're well taken care of. Thanks so much, Alexis!

I have bought three laptops within the the last 3 months and each time I have gone into Best Buy in hopes of getting service like they used to give way back when.    I assume they have decreased their staff over the years to help their bottom line.   When I have gone in there, you cannot find a sales person to help you in the computer department.   Once you do get someone, they are short and rushed and do not know the details of the technology.  They have became nothing more than a sales person.      Several years ago, Best Buy was the place to go as they would educate you on the purchase and you would leave there feeling like you at least made an informed decision.     Needless to say they are no longer training their employees on the details.     I ended up taking my three laptop purchase to FRY's because I could get my questions answered!

Dr Gettelman is awesome!  I have been terrified of dentists of any kind for my entire life.  Last year I needed a root canal, I was stunned when it was completed as it was completely painless and so quick!  While I will probably never say I enjoy going to the dentist, Dr. Gettelman makes it so much more comfortable.  Today I needed another procedure done which required more extensive work and once again it was quick and painless.  He cares about your concerns and has a very calming demeanor. His assistant is super and efficient, and the front desk staff is pleasant and helpful.  Can't say enough about this wonderful professional.  Although I hope I don't need any further dental work, if I do I know where to go.  Can't thank him enough for making my dental visit comfortable.

Simply among the best bbq in town!  The food makes up for the unassuming location.  Absolutely terrific brisket, stellar ribs, chicken, pork and sides.  Try the spicy bbq sauce if you want to add a kick-- I think they should bottle that and sell it separately.  Owner and staff are super nice.  Prices are reasonable too.  I don't write many reviews and have no affiliation with this place, just really felt compelled to post because you rarely find a place that has the right mix of great food, reasonable price, and good people.

This was by far our best family vacation to date. It will most likely will be the best for a long time to come. TWK went over and above to make this trip not only memorable but entertaining and comfortable too. 

Having never traveled to a foreign country with our teenage children, we were a little overwhelmed at trying to plan a trip. Carrie and Jeremy, the owners of Travel With Kids Family Adventure Tours, took care of almost everything for us. The only thing we had to do for this trip was book our plane reservations, which we were given several suggested flights and airlines to help us with that too. We were given itineraries, packing list and newsletters letting us know about weather, immunizations and other things we would need to get done prior to travel. They made the preparations for our trip more than easy.

The trip itself was absolutely amazing! We started in Johannesburg and a small suburb called SoWeTo to do charity work (Every family brought over backpacks with school supplies for the underprivileged children. We ended up donating about 100 backpacks) and learn about the culture and history of this area. We learned about the student uprising that started the end of Apartheid and were able to walk the same road that the students walked in their peaceful protest. It was very powerful. We are traditional African foods, saw Mandela's house and many other historical places in the city.

Next, we traveled outside of Johannesburg to the Madikwe Game Reserve to the Impodimo Game Lodge. The accommodations were beautiful! As we walked into our room, we were greeted by a herd of elephants walking by headed to the watering hole on site. We couldn't believe it! There were no barriers on the property so the animals could all roam right onto the property and did! One morning, we were awoken by two male lions talking to each other, VERY LOUDLY, and we were told to stay in our rooms and tell our rangers came to get us to walk us to the lodge.  It was very exciting! We did 8 safaris, four in the morning and four in the evening for a total of about 30 hours of game viewing! I could've spent twice as much time watching the beautiful animals in their natural environments but we were able to see every animal possible except for a leopard. Multiple male and female lions (babies too!), cheetah, elephants, giraffe, rhino, hyena, and many,  many more. The rangers we so respectful of the animals and their environment. We were in the animal's world, not the other way around and they showed tremendous respect for it. 

The food was very good and adventurous. We had traditional foods  and also different types of game animals such as warthog, impala, and kudu. Everything looked delicious and tasted the same! I wasn't sure what to expect when we went but we were all pleasantly surprised. The one food we ALL decided we never needed to eat again was tripe! Yuck! 

The staff and rangers at the lodge were so friendly and knowledgeable. I will for sure return in the future to Impodemo Game Lodge.

For the last leg of the trip, we traveled by plane to Victoria Falls in Zimbabwe. The falls were breathtaking! The town itself was small, quaint and fun to explore. We went on a fantastic sunset cruise on the Zambezi River where we saw tons of hippopotamus and a spectacular sunset. 

Overall,  we had a wonderful time on our tour and with all of the families. Carrie and Jeremy did a great job coordinating the trip and providing a fantastic trip for the families. There were a lot of things to do but we also had opportunities  to have some downtime to get to know each other and we made a lot of great friends. It was truly an experience of a lifetime and we look forward to our next adventure with the Travel With Kids Family Adventure Tours!

I attended a meeting in this property's first floor space, the Inspiration Ballroom.  The complimentary coffee and ice water were appreciated. But, the noisy air handling system was a huge distraction. The constant background humming was punctuated by loud vibrations every minute or two, ruining the ambiance and suitability for business meetings.

On the plus side, parking is far more convenient than any of the Downtown hotels.
Nice selection including a house brand that is reasonable with a really oily wrapper which is what I like.  And the place is old school to be sure....Lot's of old guys smoking cigars!!!  Will go back

I wish I could give this company negative stars. I applied to rent a home with this company. They are rude, inappropriate, and unprofessional. Wilbur Caminero is the leasing person I dealt with and he is a crook. You can tell he just wants money. The whole process seemed so fishy. I suggest you don't apply for a home with this company that is now part of Waypoint Homes unless you want to deal with untrustworthy people! Hopefully people will do their research before they decide to apply. I am glad I did before I signed a lease or paid a deposit.

This is absolutely The best Thai restaurant anywhere!  I have had  these culinary  masterpieces since they first opened and can never get tired of all the  delicious  flavors  each dish has. From the  appetizers  ( Dragon Eggs) to the specialty dishes ( Pineapple Prawns) to the unbelievable desserts ( Lemon Ginger Cheasecake)  You  could NOT be disappointed ! Ola takes great pride in all her creations and  is usually always there  right along side  her gifted  team.  I could not end this review  without  giving  kudos to the talented wait staff  who are all  great but  I gotta give a special shout out to M & A  !

Fantastic happy hour period.  Stopped in for a quick couple drinks and small plates, was not let down whatsoever.  The $4 martini's / drinks were delicious as was the Scallops and Slider small plates a friend and I enjoyed.  The place was busy for happy hour as it should be.  Really thinking I need to start hitting this place more often.  Big bar, lots of seating, perfect.  My only complaint is the no left turn on Chagrin from the lot and the forced valet parking.  I just parked on the hotel side and walked thru.  Worked out great.
I had scrub wrap massage package. Patrick is great. Wonderful experience. I will go back!!!!

It's a mall that I have been going to since I first existed in 1997. The mall has a lot of stores and free Wi-Fi. Some parts of the mall are dated such as Walmart, Sears, and the movie theatre, but it is a great place if you are looking for low to high end materials. The food court is the most exciting experience, Man Chu Wok is my favourite restaurant there and there is a KFC with a refill station. It's connected to transit, and regional services, and across the road to a Best Buy and a Loblaws Superstore.

Very clean and nicely renovated (Atleast I think it's renovated? Not sure). But their materials and design are very pretty. Super nice front desk staff. Easy in and out of the hotel to park for free. 
Also, they have such a huge variety of breakfast! There was so much food!! I love their breakfast! 
Rooms are very clean! Bed is cozy and vibrance is amazing. I was surprised of their laundry room, I don't see that quite often hahaha. There's also a gym but I didn't get to use it. The lower floor entrance, there's a place where you can sit and relax right in front of the front desk, that's also pretty neat. Looks fancy! Sorry I didn't take photos. I was too busy.
No complains here. Will definitely recommend.
Best Blimpie in the country all thanks to Kal!!! Haven't been here in over 5 years and he still remembers me!

Thought my tip would suffice but seeing some bad reviews of the place I just need to put mine in. 

The first time I ever tried Fat Burger was maybe three years ago. I never had any reason not to go to In N Out for a good and fast diner burger. But one drunken night we were in some casino (Red Rock?) where there was conveniently located, a Fat Burger. I can't deny a good old fashioned burger drunk or sober so it was on. 

I'm not dumb or close minded so I wasn't gonna compare them to In N Out or any other burger. Not every burger wants to be an In N Out burger, some burgers just wanna be themselves damnit. I really like this fat guy! He's more than doable for me and I was an instant fan.  

Plain hamburger all day every day. I'm old school. I'd eat it between sandwich bread. The patty is hand formed and made to order and while the flavor is not out of this world it is close to out of the ballpark for me. Not bad at all. I've returned many times to this location. 

Speaking of which, you'd think it's my favorite Fat Burger since there's a full bar outside. Nope. It's actually my least favorite and specifically because of the bar. The service out there sucks big baseballs. Doesn't matter if it's winter or summer, they be freezing. I've never seen so many man bitches. Soo rude and grumpy and not taking any pride in the place like the other workers inside and at their other locations. That's what confuses me. The workers inside at the counter where you order your food are excellent just like the guys at the casino. The manager here was professional and even the cooks were upbeat. I felt extremely welcomed inside and then entirely snubbed outside. 

But unless I'm feeling sensitive, it's the food that I really care about. I'd eat a decent burger from a Yankee fan I would. This here will be my drunk burger. 

I've had the garden burger which I liked fine, but I love frozen garden burgers, so. I tried the turkey burger and it was also fine so I stick to beef since we're all so fine. I prefer In N Outs protein burger because I like the full lettuce wrap as opposed to a salad set up they have here. I'll add bacon and cheese to my burgers if it's one of those nights but if I'm really trying to party I'll add an onion ring to a plain or cheeseburger. Hell yes. The onion rings are what keep me comin. Home run baby. My fave onion ring I've found in burger land.

We went in today to look at bluetooth players.  We wanted one with a USB port to play music with a stick which, apparently, is being discontinued on most models.  We were told they didn't have any that take a stick, however, we found a number of models on the shelves that took a stick.  The sales people seemed annoyed that we wanted what WE wanted and not what they thought we should buy!  We did purchase  the type of player that we went in for and are very happy with it but will never go into Fry's again.

Ate here while on our tip in Vegas for dinner. Food and service we're terrific. The guacamole served with plantains, tortilla chips and arepas was excellent. Definitely recommend the Myers Chicken. And the Chica-Rita, will redefine margaritas for me in the future!

Worst reuben sandwich I've ever had and $13, to boot.
Slow service.
$7 Fat tires.

This location is so much better than the UMC clinic Mom visited for years. The staff is attentive and courteous, and they are genuinely interested in helping clients. Mom is now here due to her doctor having transferred recently. 

We love UMC because they give good care to older clients and Mom gets the most out of her visits. It is a little more difficult for her to navigate here, but, a small price to pay to keep her old doctor.
This is so good I had to stop in the middle of the meal just to write this review. Food is awesome!

Great place for a cold beer on Roncesvalles. Really pro music acts (playing almost every time we've dropped in) - often bluegrass, but not exclusively. No cover, but the money jar comes around after each set. Have not eaten here, though there is a lot of food about. I'm mostly dropping in here for a beer en route somewhere, or after a movie next door. I appreciate the rotating taps. I have a warm fuzzy feeling for this bar as it's the first bar to help me out of a weather-related jam. Super sweet bartender spotted me just outside the place a while back, in the rain, wrestling with my broken umbrella. "I've got tons inside, let me get you one!" It's a really excellent umbrella. Thanks to the bartender, and thanks to The Local patron who left their umbrella there.

This my first Yelp post! Been a member for years and am a foodie. The Border Grill has an AWESOME BRUNCH sat and sun. Make sure you ask for Darlene B and just let her lead you through the all you can eat tapas menu. Really incredible food service and atmosphere.  A++++

This is an unethical and rude company. Our car got towed while spending money in a business in the shopping center. When we went to pick up the car, the lady at the front was so rude, talking over me and being annoyed that I had questions. She even told another employee that she hates people, right in front of me and my husband. My husband and I have contacted the company (mind you, not demanding a full refund and being very thoughtful) and NONE of our emails have been answered. If I ever need my car towed, I will remember the name Custom Towing and I will avoid them like the plague, and I will tell everyone I know not to use them. If they can't even answer an email, and with employees like that, it tells me they couldn't care less. Uninvolved owners and uninvolved managers.

I will preface this review by saying that Juhl is by far the best place I have stayed in so far. I have lived at here for exactly 2 months at this point and couldn't be more happy with my stay. Yes, it is more expensive when you compare it to some other places in Downtown LV, Summerlin or Spring Valley, but you do get beautiful amenities, decent neighbors, clean & well-maintained modern building, concierge service and a peace of mind when it comes to safety and security.

Everyone at the leasing office is very helpful & friendly. Big shout-out to Sokha for going above and beyond in helping out the residents.

As I have mentioned, Juhl has a concierge service, so you can always ship packages to your home address and someone at the front desk will sign for it.

When it comes to neighbors, most residents are pretty nice and friendly. Hallways are usually very quiet. And I cannot hear my neighbors at all thanks to the thick concrete walls. 

I live on the sixth floor so I get to enjoy a beautiful view from my window of the mountains during the day and the new City Hall at night. Spacious rooms and full-size floor to ceiling windows is one of my favorite parts of living at Juhl. But the #1 reason for moving to Juhl for me is the proximity to work - 15-minute walk or 2-minute drive in the morning.

When I used to live in North Las Vegas, it would take me a 10-15 min drive to buy some food. At Juhl, we have Le Pho (Vietnamese restaurant) and Greens & Proteins right downstairs which is super convenient when you are really hungry. And if you want more food options, Freemont Street is only a 10-12 minute walk.

When it comes to safety, I feel pretty safe walking around Juhl, 4th Street and Las Vegas Blvd. Occasionally you will run into some homeless people, but they are pretty harmless. If you walk towards the Downtown Las Vegas Premium Outlet Mall, past the bus terminal, it gets a bit sketchy at night so maybe I wouldn't walk there alone. Other than that, I feel safer living at Juhl than any other place in Las Vegas. After 10pm you can't even enter the building without the badge.

Hopefully this review was helpful. If you are considering moving to Juhl, give it a shot, I think you will enjoy it. I was so torn between living in Summerlin vs Spring Valley vs Downtown, but really glad I chose Downtown. No regrets at all.

Six of us dined there on a weekday night.  The service was outstanding and we had the pleasure of meeting the owner and a couple of highly engaged staffers.  We had five orders of  Pappardelle Bolognese and one Lobster Ravioli plus a bottle of the Montepulciano Wine - all were outstanding.  the Bolognese was more than enough and the sauce was filled with meat and very tasty.  We also had a Caesar salad and the dressing was wonderful.  The Caprese salad was not as good probably due to this being the wrong season for tasty tomatoes.  the bread melted in your mouth - it was that good!  Service was very accommodating and knowledgeable about the menu and food and very enjoyable.  All in all, an outstanding meal and evening.  We all highly recommend this place!

I'm really happy that we have an IKEA within driving distance. The downside is that it is SO convenient, that over the past 5 days, I've been there 3 times. 

Trip #1: Bought a dark brown dining table and dark brown chairs only to discover the dining table we picked up was about the length of our entire dining room.

Trip #2. Returned all of the above and purchased an "as-is" dining table and chairs that were of an incompatible color.

Trip #3. Returned chairs and purchased the chairs of the same set as the dining table.

The moral of the story is, we are not expert shoppers. But, IKEA IS expert in their customer service. We were able to return everything with ease (along with receipt and original packaging), and we eventually did get exactly what we wanted.

On each of these recent shopping excursions, we ate at the cafeteria. On Wednesday nights, with the purchase of an adult meal, you get a free kids' meal. We basically got enough food for 4 people with $10. You can't beat it! Is it the most healthy? No. But it gets the job done.

My fiance and I really liked this place. Huge step up from Stonepepper Grill. Our server was very attentive and the food was quick and on point. Tried the bruschetta, chicken parm and cajun salmon. Every dish was good and the chicken parm was better than many spots in the area. The one negative was the hostesses attitudes. They seemed stressed and frustrated that they were busy at 7pm in a Friday night which should make them happy, right?

Wow is all can say Derrick took awesome care of us came in on his day off to work a deal for us and my credit was really bad and i drove home a car after not having one for the past couple of months which was really difficult we drove away very satisfied with a car we love this place is where they get it done no matter your credit they can help

Listen to a real Asian, originally from Taiwan, looking for Chinese food in Vegas.  This place is legit, and the best non-Japanese Asian bite you will find on the Strip.  

First off, the Szechuan Beef Noodle Soup here is fantastic.  Great and relatively fantastic.  If you are craving authentic Chinese Beef Noodle Soup, it won't get better than this in Vegas.  

The Singaporean pan fried noodles were also great.  Well spiced and flavored, and like the noodles in the Beef Noodle Soup, well cooked and perfectly al dente.  

Highly recommended place, especially for you Cantonese and Taiwanese tastes.  The style of cooking here will accommodate both types of tongue.  

Oh, and they are open until late.  Highly recommended.

We won't be going back to this place.  The only good part about the experience was the drinks.  The Thai tea is great.  The food was okay but nothing special.  The decor needs a major update and the restaurant could use a good cleaning.  Someone needs to call Robert Irvine.  

The two things that make this place a 1 star review are the service and the price.  The service was some of the worst service that I've ever had in a restaurant.  We order three entrees and an appetizer.  After waiting about 15 minutes, our first entree arrived.  Somewhere in the next 5-10 minutes our appetizer arrived and then finally about 5 minutes after that the remaining two entrees arrived.  

We finished eating and had some food left over.  After about 10 minutes of the waitress ignoring our table, we decided to stack the dishes in order to get her attention.  Yeah, that didn't work.  We waited and tried to get her attention and after another 15 minutes we were successful.  We asked for To Go boxes and put our remaining food into the containers.  

After receiving the check, I was surprised at how much the bill was for the meal.  It definitely was not worth the price.  At this point, I just wanted to pay and get out of the place.  I placed my Amex card into the card slot adorned with American Express logo next to the statement of them "gladly accepting American Express" to be told by the waitress that they don't take American Express.  I don't know if I was more shocked by contradiction in credit card adornment or by the fact that the waitress was actually at our table.

I paid the bill, left a normal tip, since the waitress was hovering around cleaning the table as I tried to fill out the bill.  I then did a balancing trick with our takeout boxes since I wasn't afforded the luxury of a bag (maybe you need to spend more in order to receive a bag) and hurried out of the place with my family.

I was excited to try a new place near our house but sadly the experience was lacking and I won't be returning.  Hopefully the next place we try will be better.

Alright, you know what? I loved the idea of Rite Aid when it first came out, a no-lose shopping experience, sort of a nicer Walgreens. Then CVS came along and blew that out of the water - until I realized how inflated CVS prices are but that's another story.

I've been to this particular Rite Aid at least five times and all five times ran into something stupid about it. The layout, for one thing, makes no sense and is a total cluster. The pricing is out of whack ($5 for deodorant? $7 for body wash?). The staff is not friendly and today just clinched it.

I popped in to find a birthday card for my mom, preferably humorous. In one aisle of both female-specific and gender-neutral cards, there was one (ONE) funny mom-specific card option. One. The rest were schmaltzy, flowery cards totally lame for the occasion. If I wanted a birthday card for a female, I would have had to purchase one of the insanely many Viagara/boobs/porn/dick joke-themed offerings. Seriously? Mom's cool and funny but she's not a 20 year old college student.

It's the closest convenient store to my house so I know I'll return but I really won't want to.

Great concept but needs more variety. Bought this for my brother for his bday. He was visiting from NY. Very disappointed because we had only 1 car choice to drive. I bought the muscle car test drive. Called to make a reservation and was told no appt necessary just come in. When we get there there's only one car that's available and the other is "reserved" ( but I thought they don't take reservations). So he got to drive a challenger which he liked but I wish he had more of a choice of muscle cars to choose from. Overall kinda disappointed

My 7th time in Vegas, 1st time here.  You NEED to check it out.  Get a Bloody Mary and wait by fire pit until your table is ready.  Huge portions, good comfort food.  People that complain that it's expensive (which it's not) are best advised to hit the nearby Denny's.

We dropped in here last night to enjoy this place as my boyfriend loves coming here. It was really crowded and there were no seats, so we decided to try somewhere else just for comfort. As we came up the stairs...the guy that was checking IDs was tending to a group of three gentleman. What I heard next was so shocking and such a disappointment. He told the gentlemen "You two can come in, but I can't let you in with those face tattoos." 
WHAT?! Are you SERIOUS?! I was SOOOO upset at hearing that! How can you discriminate like that!!? Disgusting. I was so glad that I didn't give my money to that place. It worked out like that for a reason. We'll never come here again. Such a sad thing truth hear.
The selection of sauces is awesome! We love to come here to stock up, and the staff are always super friendly! Definitely worth a drop in to check it out, at least!
This place did not help me at all every little bit of help I asked for they looked at me like I was stupid and they're very rude I hope everyone in the pharmacy gets fired

Service was terrible. We waited 45 minutes to be seated. We were told 30 and that's fine except for when a lady walked in who appeared to be a regular, gave the hostess a hug and asked if she could find her a table for 3 and was seated right away. It was frustrating because they have a limited number of seating for two people so larger parties were being seated before us. Once we were seated the service was very slow and we only saw our waiter twice. Once to take our drink order and once to take our food order. Once we got our food my boyfriend asked for maple syrup and never got it. Also, we observed that the table of four next to us who were seated way before is finally got their food and we were already done. What?! The food was ok. The experience blew.
Been here twice with my husband both times very impressed with food and service.

Staff was super knowledgeable and attentive, walked me through the store and helped me pick out food for my puppy as well as make several suggestions on future purchases as my baby grows. Can't wait to go back and bring the pup with me! Such a great shop!

Great place to show fresh produce. I wish it had a bigger  NATURAL FOOD section. But cashiers are friendly, they do price match and the store is big, bright and orginzed. Definitly better than walmart.

My boyfriend and I visit Lucky Thai at least once a week whether it's through to go services or in house. Lucky Thai has continued to be one of our favorites for both their gracious and speedy service but really how delicious the food always is! My personal favorites are the yellow chicken curry and, when I'm in the mood for something sweet and spicy, the pineapple curry really hits the spot. This restaurant is truly a hole in the wall but so worth the visit!

I love this brewery! It's never super packed, the staff is as friendly as they come and the beers are excellent. Each beer is inspired by important female figures presently and in history. Awesome theme! Inside is always really clean, bright and inviting. Outdoor patio is a bit small but I've never seen it fully packed. They have a corn hole board, jenga and other games to play. Dogs are strictly allowed outside but they usually keep the garage door from the inside to the patio open, so it doesn't feel like you're shunned with your pup. Great place to watch some games, snack on a hot dog and relax!

The fresh produce is probably my favorite thing about fry's... also it is very convenient that the pharmacy price matches prescription prices. Also I love the fact that I can get the farm fresh milk in the glass bottles there... also return the empty glass container back for more milk or cash back. Yay!
Stopped here on the way home from visiting and instantly fell in love. Will be a required stop any time we're in town from now on.

Clean.  Hip.  Casual. Contemporary.  Decorated by Ikea.

Good stopping point on the way home.
My coffee was made with passion, you like coffee come by here for a unique cup! The place is set up for study along with Music for just hanging out.  Please give it a shot

Was a little disappointed... The food was sitting out on the counter, the cook used microwave to re-warm it up. Chicken meal was sent to me cold, not even warm, the beef was hot but all dried out, almost jerky like. 

Think it's best to keep driving right past it!

So, i've heard SO much about this place and of course have come across their amazing Yelp reviews so on Saturday night, we decided to give it a try! It definitely did not disappoint! It is a hole-in-the-wall, super casual, and very authentic. I LOVE their salsa bar that also had fresh radishes, cucumbers, roasted peppers, and more. BEWARE: The peppers are pretty spicy! But thanks to their refreshing bottled grapefruit soda, the numbness went away in no time. 

I ordered 3 tacos - pollo, carne asada, and carnitas. All were delicious and I would absolutely get them again! My favorite was the carne asada, the marinade on the meat was so tasty! Also, my fiance ordered a rajas gordita (vegetarian) and it was so fantastic. This is an absolute must. It is a tortilla pocket filled with cheese, roasted jalapenos, and hatch chiles. Lastly, I ordered their 'bean soup' which is pinto beans with a few different meats and a fantastic broth. 

I recommend eating at the restaurant to get an authentic experience and of course, take full advantage of their fresh salsa bar. They even had a cute, young mariachi band playing in the background. We'll absolutely be back!

There's just something about the fountains at Bellagio. Beautiful when you catch them walking by. Mesmerizing when you catch them a little sauced. But most importantly free! Still an impressive sight to behold and a landmark of the strip!
